cardDesc: A carry-on-friendly list for a 2-3 day getaway — outfits, toiletries, tech, and easy-to-forget extras.
intro: This weekend packing list keeps a 2-3 day getaway to a single carry-on. The trick is a one-color-family wardrobe, so a handful of pieces mix into every outfit. It works for a city break, a countryside escape, or a visit home. Browse more travel and packing checklists.

items.text: ID or passport and your booking confirmations
items.note: Screenshot them in case there's no signal.

items.text: Phone charger and a power bank
Two-to-three days of clothes in one color family
Pajamas, plus fresh socks and underwear per day and one spare
A light layer — sweater or jacket — for evenings
Comfortable walking shoes, plus one dressier pair

items.note: The cabin liquid limit for carry-on.

items.text: Chargers and cables for every device
A book, headphones, or downloaded shows for the journey
A small day bag or tote for outings
House keys and a card for parking or transit
A foldable tote or laundry bag for dirty clothes

faq.q: What do I need for a weekend trip?
faq.a: For a 2-3 day trip, pack documents and chargers, two-to-three mix-and-match outfits, one dressier option, travel-size toiletries, medications, and a day bag. Keeping to one color family means fewer clothes that still all work together.

faq.q: How many outfits for a 2-night trip?
faq.a: Two to three tops, one or two bottoms, and one "nice" outfit is plenty for two nights. Choose pieces in the same color family so they layer and mix, and you'll rarely need more.

faq.q: Can I pack for a weekend in a carry-on only?
faq.a: Yes. A weekend easily fits a carry-on if you keep toiletries under 100ml, wear your bulkiest shoes and jacket on the journey, and stick to one color family so a few pieces cover every outfit.
